data.long_meaning: Thiago is a Portuguese name derived from the Greek word 'Thiasos', which means 'divine, holy thing'. In Christianity, it can be interpreted as 'God's gift' or 'God's grace'. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Thiago usually hope their child will grow to embody god's gift and live with faith, good character and purpose.
